image_description: A full-body side view of an American Bison standing on a dirt path with grass and a tree trunk in the background. The bison has a massive, shaggy dark brown forequarter with a prominent shoulder hump, transitioning to smoother, lighter brown fur on the hindquarters. It has a large head with short curved horns, a visible beard, and sturdy legs ending in hooves.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible, appearing large and broad relative to the body. Short, curved horns are distinctly present on the top of the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct fringe of long, dark hair hangs from the chin and throat area, matching the description of a bison beard.
The eye is visible on the side of the head and appears dark/black, consistent with the species.
Small, triangular ears are visible poking through the thick fur on the side of the head; they are not completely hidden but are small and surrounded by fur as expected.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits a massive, heavy build. The withers (shoulder area) are significantly higher than the rump, creating the characteristic sloping back profile of a bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forequarters are covered in thick, shaggy dark brown fur that forms a very prominent, rounded hump at the shoulders.
There is a clear visual transition where the fur on the rear half of the body is shorter, smoother, and lighter in color compared to the dense mane on the front.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are relatively short and curved, appearing small in proportion to the massive size of the head and body.
All four legs are visible and appear sturdy/columnar. The feet end in dark, split structures consistent with cloven hooves.
The tail is visible hanging down between the hind legs; it is short and ends in a distinct tuft of darker hair.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification and rule out hybrid or generic bovid errors.
To verify the structural integrity of the four legs and the connection of the hump to the spine, ensuring no limb fusion or extra limbs.
To check for 'melting' artifacts where the shaggy fur blends into the background or where the beard merges incorrectly with the chest.
To assess texture consistency in the fur and detect any subtle AI-generation noise or blur.

focus_areas: Fur texture transition between forequarters and hindquarters
Structural connection of the shoulder hump to the neck and spine
Hoof definition and ground contact shadows
Edge sharpness of the beard against the chest
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the topology of the shaggy fur. AI often struggles with complex fur boundaries, causing them to bleed into the background or look like painted smears rather than individual strands. Verify that the 'hump' is structurally supported by the skeleton and not just a texture overlay. Check the hooves for clarity, as they are often distorted in AI generations.
